text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Almond Eye dropped a precious keychain of hers,
and we've come to the shrine to search for it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I stopped by here when doing the perimeter run...
It was definitely here at that time.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been feeling well lately, and now this bad luck...
...I really hope it turns up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. It's the one I always carry around,
with Kyumaru holding a heart.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I've mentioned it before. Um... this really means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we split up to search the shrine grounds, I remember.
If I recall correctly, she once said this—
choice_data_list: (She said it matches her dad's, didn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: My dad bought that for me the very first time I stayed home alone.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Daddy will be lonely too, but I'll look at this and do my best, so you do your best too, Ai!"
...And that was just for 30 minutes of watching the house, you know? Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said the metal fittings were completely worn out
and kept coming undone.
Still, she must cherish it a lot to carry it around like that.
choice_data_list: (...No matter what, I want to help her find it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However, despite their hopes, the keychain was nowhere to be found in the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for helping me look.
The sun's setting, so let's head home soo—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...! Whoops, excuse me.
You were praying, weren't you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's hope we find Ai's keychain.
Yeah, so we can find the Ai keychain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Relying on divine intervention feels pathetic, but...
I wanted to do whatever I could for her.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I'll do it too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Hello, God.
I am an Umamusume attending Tracen Academy,
and my name is Almond Eye.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Actually, I recently lost a precious keychain due to my own carelessness.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I am truly sorry to trouble you, God, but...
Please, lend me your strength so that I may find it.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I'll do my best on my own to get back in shape
and win races—so please, hear my wish.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
Shall we search a bit more on our way back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, as we walked home while looking for the key chain...

text_block_list.name: Old Woman on a Walk
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, dear.
Isn't that the girl? Look, the one from the lost and found!

text_block_list.name: Old Man on a Walk
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's right, that's right!
...Little lady, did you drop this by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ! Heart's Cry...!

text_block_list.name: Old Man on a Walk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I knew it! Ah, I saw you drop it
during my morning walk, you see?
Though you were running so fast, I couldn't catch up...

text_block_list.name: Old Woman on a Walk
text_block_list.text:
It looked like you really treasured it, so I kept it safe for you.
Glad everything worked out!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much...!
Truly, truly, thank you from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her treasure safely back in hand, Almond Eye's worries cleared away,
and she was back in top form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, on that day, nothing was found in the end.
Almond Eye's condition showed little sign of improving.
